perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Lone Wolf
enhanced.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

enhanced.name: Enlightened Action
enhanced.description: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

enhanced.name: Repulsor Brace
enhanced.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

enhanced.name: Cornered
enhanced.description: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Controlled Burst
enhanced.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Withering Gaze
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.
